item.title: Ireland Is Banning Vape Flavors. This Shop Owner Warns It Could Cost Lives.
item.description: Ireland's planned restrictions on vape flavours are raising concerns among independent retailers and former smokers who rely on non-tobacco flavours to stay away from cigarettes. (Published on October 29, 2026byreason.com)

item.title: No Clear Rules | Mi-Pod’s Finance Chief on Uncertainty Facing U.S. Vaping | RegWatch
item.description: Unclear federal regulations and conflicting state restrictions are creating significant challenges for US vaping businesses, affecting compliance, financial planning and long-term stability. (Published on October 29, 2026byregulatorwatch.com)
